state.title: $plan = (Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'output\itinerary.json' | ConvertFrom-Json).plan; if ($plan.Count -ne 7) { throw 'Expected seven days.' }; if (($plan | Where-Object { [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_.attraction) -or $_.attraction -eq '-' }).Count) { throw 'Every day needs an attraction.' }; if (($plan | Where-Object { $_.transportation -match '(?i)flight' }).Count) { throw 'Flights are prohibited.' }; 'JSON parsed; seven days; daily attractions; no flights.'
